consent.title: Before analyzing
consent.what: To analyze it, RiskLex will send the text of the document to the RiskLex backend, which passes it to Anthropic, its artificial intelligence provider. A random identifier for this installation and the app version are sent with the text, with no personal data.
consent.retention: Anthropic may keep the data temporarily: up to 30 days, or longer if some content is flagged for review. RiskLex does not keep copies on its servers.
consent.link: If you read a link, the page was downloaded from your computer and the site could see your IP address. Only the text is sent to the AI, not the link address or the file name.
consent.advice: Do not paste information you do not want to share, such as passwords or health data.
consent.session: We will remember your answer on this computer. If this notice changes, we will ask you again.
consent.history: If the history is on, the result, with its quotes from the document, is saved on this computer. You can delete it in History or turn the history off in Settings.

settings.title: Settings

settings.saveFailed: We could not save the change on this computer. It will apply until you close RiskLex.

history.hint: Results are saved with their quotes from the document, never the full document.

history.title: History
